messages:
anya: hey team — running into a weird one with redwoodctl localtest: credentials seem to be picked up from a symlinked ~/.config/redwood/credentials that's actually a Windows path mounted into WSL. localtest auth succeeds locally but CI fails. anyone seen redwoodctl prefer embedded creds in the binary over profile files?
sam: which version of redwoodctl? run `redwoodctl --version`
anya: `redwoodctl 0.12.3` on WSL2 + Windows 11, but CI uses alpine container with 0.12.3 too.
marco: we had a precedence bug (profile vs env vs embedded) fixed in 0.13.0. 0.12.x would treat an embedded creds file under /etc/redwood/creds as higher priority. can you `strace` or run with `RCTL_DEBUG=1`?
anya: thanks — ran with RCTL_DEBUG=1 and saw `loading credentials from /mnt/c/Users/anya/.redwood/creds (platform windows)` even though $HOME points to /home/anya
tess: ugh windows symlink overlay. localtest spawns a helper that resolves symlinks differently. try setting `REDWOOD_CONFIG=/home/anya/.config/redwood` explicitly for localtest
anya: setting REDWOOD_CONFIG fixes it locally but CI still flakes when we run tests in a docker: '401 unauthorized' only for ephemeral profiles. here's the failing command: ```docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_CONFIG=/root/.config/redwood my-app-tests```
marco: CI container might have /root/.config symlinked from build agent, and redwoodctl caches tokens in `~/.cache/redwood/token.json`. 0.12.x used absolute path resolution, not inode checks; race on volume mounts. The fix in 0.13 switches to profile-ID hashed cache paths.
sam: long term, two options: upgrade redwoodctl in CI to >=0.13.0, or add explicit `--profile` to localtest command: `redwoodctl login --profile ci-ephemeral --non-interactive`
anya: we're on a pinned image for reproducibility; can we backport a patch? also, would `redwoodctl logout --all` help in CI setup?
tess: logout --all clears cache but not embedded creds. if you need backport I'll open a tiny PR that changes precedence to env override first. CC @marco
marco: opening PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/pull/4523 : changes precedence + adds unit test for symlinked HOME. adding release note.
devex-bot: deploybot: created branch redwoodctl/fix/credential-precedence (CI job queued). :rocket:
anya: legend — thanks. Will try upgrade in CI and fallback to explicit REDWOOD_CONFIG if needed. saving the debug log in case we need to revert.
sam: :thumbsup:
